title: Travel agency panel — browser test report
area: Travel Partner panel (travel-agency) and storefront travel
summary: Playwright browser test of every Travel Partner page (11 of 11 sidebar items, plus Notifications and Sign-in history) and the agency's full trip lifecycle on data created by the run: package with two departures and room prices, contract upload, review and approval, capacity change, guest and signed-in booking requests (no payment, D8) confirmed and rejected, a traveller inquiry, a Sponsored promotion paid through the fake card gateway with failed, pending and captured outcomes (D14) and the promoted trip leading website search with the Sponsored label (EN/AR). Team roles, change requests, support, Arabic RTL, 2FA sign-in and password-reset mail were also covered. 14 tests, all passing on the final run. Two bugs were found and fixed: the sidebar showed pages a team role cannot open, and read-only roles saw action buttons that the server refuses.
environment: API + panels http://localhost:8000; panel host travel-agency.nawy.test:8000 (Chromium host-resolver-rules)

issues.area: All panels (seen on Travel Partner, also Seller Center)
issues.description: The sidebar only hid items whose route needs a `can:` permission and ignored team-role `tenant.can:` middleware, so a Finance member saw Packages, Departures, Inquiries, Change requests and Team & permissions, which all return 403.
issues.fix: PanelNavigation::allowed() also checks `tenant.can:{panel},{group}` (read) through TenantPermissions. Regression test in tests/Feature/QaWave1TenantPermissionsTest.php ('the sidebar hides pages the team role cannot open').

issues.area: Travel Partner: Bookings, Inquiries, Promotions, Promote a trip, Dashboard
issues.description: Read-only roles (Finance/Viewer) were shown Confirm/Reject/Cancel, inquiry status, Pay by card, Promote a trip and New package controls that the server refuses with 403.
issues.fix: The views show those controls only when TenantPermissions allows a write; Promote a trip shows a read-only notice instead of the buy form (Arabic string added). Covered by the same Pest test and by TRV-11.

notes: Sidebar coverage: 11 of 11 'travel_agency' navigation items, plus Notifications and Account security from the top bar.

No Documents, Ads, Settings or Staff page exists in the Travel Partner panel (PanelNavigation and routes): staff is 'Team & permissions' and profile changes go through 'Change requests'. Paid placement is 'Promotions' (D14); there is no separate Ads page.
D11: no commission field or text in the package editor or dashboard; the promote page states listing is free with no commission.
D8: booking requests have no payment step; the agency confirms and is paid directly by the customer.

Promotion slots are capped (travel.promotion_slots = 3, rotating). The spec cancels earlier browser-test promotions of throwaway trips before buying, otherwise repeated runs fill the slots and the new trip may be out of rotation (expected behaviour, not a bug).

The fake gateway redirect is intercepted by fetching the 'Pay by card' POST without following redirects (Playwright cannot route a browser-followed redirect), scripting the outcome with FakeGateway::willReport, then going to the panel return URL.
Password reset was not completed so the shared seeded password stays unchanged.
Booking modifications (customer change requests on a booking) were not exercised: no storefront flow created one in this run.
Each run leaves test data: a trip 'E2E Trip <run>' (active), two bookings, an inquiry, a paid promotion, a Finance member, a support ticket and a cancelled change request.
